clauses.quote: Section 44973 shall be waived upon acceptance of the leave.
The District shall make a good faith effort to reinstate the unit member in the position held at the time the leave was granted.

Each employee who has been on sabbatical leave shall file with the Division Superintendent the completed material that was agreed to at the time the leave was approved not later than thirty (30) duty days after return to his assigned duty.
clauses.subject_text: Each employee who has been on sabbatical leave

clauses.quote: In addition, a report shall be filed giving specific information on employment accepted and compensation received therefrom during the period of the sabbatical leave.
All such material shall then be presented to the Board of Education for approval.
Transcripts of college and university work shall be supplied the District.
clauses.subject_text: Transcripts of college and university work

clauses.quote: Payment for service rendered after return to duty cannot be made until either (1) these documents are filed with the Superintendent and approved by the Board of Education, or (2) a statement is filed that the employee is not going to fulfill the leave requirements.
clauses.subject_text: Payment for service rendered after return to duty

clauses.quote: no compensation may be paid for such leave
any such compensation received must be refunded.
In all matters in which this Section is in conflict with the Education Code, the provisions of the Education Code shall prevail.
clauses.subject_text: the provisions of the Education Code

clauses.quote: the credential or permit held at the time the leave was granted, properly authorizing service, must be maintained in full force by the unit member.
clauses.subject_text: the credential or permit held at the time the leave was granted, properly authorizing service
